title: Administrator-only provider verification workflow (frontend UI + React Query wiring)

requirements.summary: Implement a functional Administrator verification review UI (browse providers, review profile + documents, Verify action) with admin-only access control and feedback states.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/pages/backoffice/VerificationReviewPage.tsx no longer shows a “future update” placeholder and instead renders a working review experience for admins.
The page is access-controlled using the existing admin check (useIsCallerAdmin) and shows a clear access denied state for non-admins.
The Administrator can select a provider, view their profile fields, see current verification status, and click “Verify” to set status to Verified; the UI refreshes to show the updated status.
Verification actions show loading/progress state and success/error feedback.

file_operations.description: Replace the placeholder card with an admin-only review workflow: list providers needing review, allow selecting a provider to view full profile details (identity + service info + submitted verification documents via direct URLs) and current verificationStatus, and provide a single “Verify” button that triggers the admin verification mutation with loading/disabled state and success/error messaging. Use existing shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card, Alert, Button, Badge) for layout/feedback. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query query/mutation hooks used by the admin review page: (a) fetch list of providers requiring verification review, (b) fetch a specific provider’s full review view, (c) perform the “Verify” action. Ensure the hooks expose pending/loading and error states for UI rendering.

requirements.summary: Implement provider document upload + submission UI showing verification status (Unverified/Pending/Verified/Rejected) with rejection reason and refetch after submit.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/pages/provider/VerificationUploadPage.tsx provides file upload inputs for the required document types (academic qualifications and certificate of good conduct) and a submission control to send them for review.
After submission, the provider’s verificationStatus becomes Pending and the UI reflects the updated state via refetch.
If verificationStatus is Rejected, the rejection reason is displayed to the provider.
All user-facing strings in this flow refer to “Administrator” (not “technical team”).

file_operations.description: Replace placeholder copy with a working provider flow: show current verificationStatus (Unverified/Pending/Verified/Rejected) and, when Rejected, display the rejection reason; add file inputs for required documents (academic qualification(s) and certificate of good conduct), show selected filenames, and provide a “Submit for Administrator Review” action that uploads documents using blob-storage ExternalBlob and triggers a submit mutation. Include upload progress and disable submit while uploading/submitting. Use existing shadcn-ui components for inputs/buttons/alerts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query mutation hook(s) for provider document submission that accept the selected files, convert them to blob-storage ExternalBlob instances (with upload progress), and call the backend capability to submit documents; on success, invalidate/refetch current profile so verificationStatus shows Pending immediately.

requirements.summary: Update verification-related terminology to use “Administrator” instead of “technical team” across provider and admin tooling UI.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/pages/backoffice/ProviderDatasetToolsPanel.tsx headings/descriptions replace “Technical Team Tools” with “Administrator Tools” (or equivalent) while preserving meaning.
No remaining visible UI copy in verification/admin review areas refers to “technical team”.

file_operations.description: Update all status/help text and any submission guidance to refer to “Administrator” (including Pending/Verified messaging), and ensure the Rejected state copy remains clear and in English.

Replace the “Technical Team Tools” heading/description text with “Administrator Tools” (or equivalent) in both the admin and non-admin render paths while preserving meaning. Continue using existing shadcn-ui components for alerts/dialogs. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure all admin review UI copy uses “Administrator” terminology consistently (including access denied state messaging) and remove any lingering “technical team” references.

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks and UI wiring for verification/document backend capabilities with proper cache invalidation and user-readable error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (or a new non-immutable hooks file) includes mutations/queries for provider document submission and admin verification actions.
After successful mutations, the app invalidates/refetches at least ['currentUserProfile'] and any provider/admin review lists so updated verificationStatus is visible immediately.
Non-admin errors from admin endpoints are surfaced to the UI in a user-readable way.

file_operations.description: Implement the verification React Query layer: add query keys for admin review lists and provider review detail, plus mutations for provider document submission and admin verification. On success, invalidate/refetch at minimum ['currentUserProfile'] and the relevant admin/provider review list/detail queries. Standardize error normalization (e.g., mapping authorization failures into a user-readable message) so pages can show friendly errors.

Update the TypeScript backend interface declarations to include the new verification/document backend capabilities (provider submission, admin list/review fetch, admin verify/reject) so the new hooks/pages can call them without type errors.

Wire the new hooks into the admin review UI: use React Query data for provider lists/details, trigger the Verify mutation, and ensure the UI refreshes based on invalidations (no full reload). Display backend authorization failures and other errors in a user-readable way using existing shadcn-ui Alert components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new submission mutation into the provider upload page and refetch via query invalidation after success. Ensure submission/authorization errors are displayed clearly (English) and that status changes appear immediately after refetch.
